scored_papers.title: Intertwining Defects and Fermion-Boundary Scattering from TQFT
scored_papers.abstract: We construct conformal boundary conditions of free Dirac fermions that preserve chiral, anomaly-free symmetries, and determine the associated fermion-boundary scattering, using the TQFT/CFT framework. We apply the construction to several previously unresolved examples: higher-charge monopoles in non-chiral QED, a family of $SU(N)\times SU(N+2)$-symmetric models, the chiral QED with charges $\{1^5,3,(-2)^4\}$, and the charge-three monopole of the Standard Model. In these examples, out-going states are created by defect operators at the end of non-invertible topological lines; when such a line is non-simple, the out-going state splits into superselection sectors, and we give a formula for the branching ratios in terms of TQFT data. We also propose a general construction that adds and then gaps neutral spectators, under a technical assumption, which is potentially applicable to the 1-5-7-8-9 model.
scored_papers.reason: 🔥 カイラル・アノマリーフリー対称性を保つ境界条件の構成で、3450型カイラルゲージ理論や1-5-7-8-9模型の文脈と直結！⚛️ 対称性保存境界の格子実現を考える上でも示唆大🧩
scored_papers.summary: TQFT/CFT 手法で自由 Dirac fermion の共形境界条件と fermion-境界散乱を決定。非可逆線の端点欠陥で出射状態を記述し、分岐比を TQFT データで与える📐

scored_papers.title: Fermions Scattering Off Non-Abelian Rotors
scored_papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of $d=1+1$ chiral fermions interacting with a rotor impurity. The rotors are non-Abelian, taking values in either an $SU(N)$ group manifold, or an $SU(N)/SO(N)$ coset. At low energies, the fermions pass through the impurity, seemingly unimpeded, but trailing a topological line that is necessary for current conservation. In certain cases, these topological lines exhibit non-Abelian fusion and braiding. This can be viewed as a toy model that captures aspects of s-wave monopole-fermion scattering in $d=3+1$ dimensions.

scored_papers.summary: 1+1次元カイラル fermion と SU(N) / SU(N)/SO(N) 値の非可換 rotor 不純物の相互作用を解析。低エネルギーで fermion はトポロジカル線を伴い透過し、非可換 fusion/braiding を示す📊
